task: What OS and C library do our fork's self-hosted CI runners use?
Should our fork's builds switch the default ref storage to reftable?
gold: No, the fork decided not to make reftable the default (this year)
Because the backup tooling rsyncs .git/refs/ and packed-refs directly and would silently back up nothing under reftable

task: What is the most recent measurement we have of git status speed on our monorepo?
gold: Median 1.8 s with fsmonitor off and 0.4 s with core.fsmonitor=true
Measured 2026-09-20 on 2.1 million tracked files, 15 runs each

task: Will HTTPS fetches from our internal mirror use protocol v2?
gold: No: the corporate HTTP proxy strips the Git-Protocol header
So fetches silently fall back to protocol v0

task: How long can a CI job run on our self-hosted runners before it is killed?
gold: Does not present 45 minutes as the current limit (45 was an earlier figure that was corrected)
